from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, statistics, os
r = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = Path(os.environ["TEMP"]) / "llmx-worker-spans"
manifest = json.loads((source / "manifest.json").read_text())
rows = json.loads((source / "results.json").read_text())
labels = ["qkv", "attention", "attention_output", "gate_up", "ffn_down"]
verified = {}
def verify(name):
    raw = (source / name).read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    expected = manifest["artifacts"].get(name)
    assert expected == digest, (name, expected, digest)
    verified[name] = digest
    return raw
for name in ["results.json", "source-hashes.json", "spans.cpp", "worker_spans.hpp"]:
    verify(name)
for arm in ["control", "current"]:
    for name in ["src/model/arch_qwen.hpp", "src/backends/cpu/cpu_backend.hpp"]:
        verify((arm + "/" + name).replace("/", "\\"))
records = []
for row in rows:
    if row["mode"] != "spans": continue
    doc = json.loads(verify(row["name"] + ".stdout"))
    assert len(doc["tg"]) == 32 * 141
    totals = {}
    for i, rec in enumerate(doc["tg"]):
        within = i % 141
        op = labels[within % 5] if within < 140 else "vocab"
        returned = rec[0]; entry = rec[1::2]; leave = rec[2::2]
        assert len(entry) == len(leave) == 6
        assert all(0 <= a <= b <= returned for a, b in zip(entry, leave))
        w = max(range(6), key=lambda v: leave[v])
        d = totals.setdefault(op, dict(count=0, entry_ns=0, callback_ns=0, completion_ns=0, dispatch_ns=0, last_participant=[0]*6))
        d["count"] += 1; d["entry_ns"] += entry[w]
        d["callback_ns"] += leave[w] - entry[w]
        d["completion_ns"] += returned - leave[w]
        d["dispatch_ns"] += returned; d["last_participant"][w] += 1
    assert sum(t["dispatch_ns"] for t in totals.values()) <= doc["tg_ms"] * 1e6
    for op, d in totals.items():
        assert d["count"] == (32 if op == "vocab" else 32*28)
        assert d["entry_ns"] + d["callback_ns"] + d["completion_ns"] == d["dispatch_ns"]
    records.append(dict(name=row["name"],model=row["model"],arm=row["arm"],pair=row["pair"],phase_ms=doc["tg_ms"],operations=totals))
summary=[]
for model in ["q8", "f32"]:
    for arm in ["control", "current"]:
        selected=[x for x in records if x["model"]==model and x["arm"]==arm]
        assert len(selected)==3
        for op in labels + ["vocab"]:
            means={k[:-3]+"_ms_per_token":statistics.mean(x["operations"][op][k] for x in selected)/32/1e6 for k in ["entry_ns","callback_ns","completion_ns","dispatch_ns"]}
            summary.append(dict(model=model,arm=arm,operation=op,**means))
out=dict(status="computed; dispatch mapping requires accompanying source review",source_manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256((source/"manifest.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),base_commits=manifest["base_commits"],scope="Historical instrumented 0.6B decode only. No new timing, no causal regression or speed claim; group members are not separated.",mapping="i//141 token; r=i%141; r<140: layer=r//5, op=[qkv,attention,attention_output,gate_up,ffn_down][r%5]; r=140: vocab",verified=verified,records=records,summary=summary)
(r/"analysis.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+"\n")
for x in summary:
    print(x["model"],x["arm"],x["operation"]," ".join(str(round(x[k+"_ms_per_token"],5)) for k in ["entry","callback","completion","dispatch"]))
